page.layout: One printed page: title page. Top: author's name in spaced italic capitals, then the large title in roman capitals, centred. Below: a centred list of six numbered items, then a centred italic imprint line. Under that: a woodcut device with a motto, then the publisher's imprint and date centred at the foot.

main_text.l: IV. De præsentia in cultu Idololatrico.
V. De fuga in persequutione & peste.
VI. An Deus sit author peccati?
Oxonia anno 1597. in schola Theologica propofita, ibidem edita: & nunc primum in Germania recusa.

page.notes: The woodcut device (a figure in a landscape with a sun and a motto in a circular frame, the motto reading roughly "INVENIAM ... INVENIENT") is not transcribed as text. The motto is partly illegible and is not transcribed. Handwritten shelfmark "362 Th.(11)" in the upper right and the page mark "II" in the top corner are handwriting and are omitted. The library stamp and scale on the right and the digitiser's footer are omitted. The first word of the title line "GEORGII ABBATTI" is printed in a spaced italic style, which is rendered here in capitals.
